probe_meta.label: dense-G (controlled retrieval-mechanism swap of Probe G)

response_text:
1. (Currently Amended) A method comprising: __a processor__ determining that a benefit payment is due to be made to a recipient; __the processor__ accessing a data store containing records of payment transactions made by the recipient; __the processor__ receiving an indication from the data store that the recipient had successfully performed a biometric user authentication with respect to at least one of the payment transactions; __the processor__ accepting the received indication as proof-of-life with respect to the recipient; and __the processor__ making the benefit payment to the recipient in response to said proof-of-life, __wherein the method further comprises: accessing a computer system comprising the processor and memory; and executing program instructions on the processor to perform the determining, accessing, receiving, accepting, and making steps__.

2. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 1, wherein said at least one payment transaction occurred during a pre-determined period of time prior to said accessing step __by the processor__.

3. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 2, wherein said pre-determined period of time is seven days.

4. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 2, wherein said pre-determined period of time is 24 hours.

5. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 1, wherein the benefit payment is a social insurance transfer payment __made by the processor via an electronic system__.

6. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 1, wherein the at least one of the payment transactions includes a credit card account transaction and/or a debit card account transaction __processed by the processor__.

7. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 6, wherein a mobile device was used by the recipient to initiate the at least one payment transaction __and the processor accesses records of such transactions from the data store__.

8. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 1, wherein the benefit payment is made via an electronic monetary transfer to an account owned by the recipient __by the processor__.

9. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 1, wherein the benefit payment is made by __the processor__ sending a check to the recipient.

10. (Currently Amended) A method comprising: __a processor__ determining that a benefit payment is due to be made to a recipient; __the processor__ accessing, at a first point in time, a data store containing records of payment transactions made by the recipient; __the processor__ determining that the data store contains an indication that the recipient had successfully performed a biometric user authentication most recently with respect to one of said payment transactions at a second point in time earlier than the first point in time; __the processor__ comparing a time interval defined by the second and first points in time with a pre-determined permissive time interval; __the processor__ making the benefit payment, without requiring proof-of-life authentication of the recipient, in a case where the time interval defined by the second and first points in time does not exceed the pre-determined permissive time interval; and __the processor__ requiring proof-of-life authentication of the recipient, prior to making the benefit payment, in a case where the time interval defined by the second and first points in time exceeds the pre-determined permissive time interval, __wherein the method further comprises: accessing a computer system comprising the processor and memory; and executing program instructions on the processor to perform the determining, accessing, comparing, and making steps__.

11. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 10, wherein the pre-determined permissive time interval is seven days.

12. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 10, wherein the pre-determined permissive time interval is 24 hours.

13. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 10, wherein the benefit payment is a social insurance transfer payment __made by the processor via an electronic system__.

14. (Original) An apparatus comprising: a processor; and a memory in communication with the processor, the memory storing program instructions, the processor operative with the program instructions to perform functions as follows: determining that a benefit payment is due to be made to a recipient; accessing a data store containing records of payment transactions made by the recipient; receiving an indication from the data store that the recipient had successfully performed a biometric user authentication with respect to at least one of the payment transactions; accepting the received indication as proof-of-life with respect to the recipient; and making the benefit payment to the recipient in response to said proof-of-life.

15. (Currently Amended) The apparatus of claim 14, wherein said at least one payment transaction occurred during a pre-determined period of time prior to said accessing __by the processor__.

16. (Currently Amended) The apparatus of claim 15, wherein said pre-determined period of time is seven days.

17. (Currently Amended) The apparatus of claim 15, wherein said pre-determined period of time is 24 hours.

18. (Currently Amended) The apparatus of claim 14, wherein the benefit payment is a social insurance transfer payment __made by the processor via an electronic system__.

19. (Currently Amended) The apparatus of claim 14, wherein the at least one of the payment transactions includes a credit card account transaction and/or a debit card account transaction __processed by the processor__.

20. (Currently Amended) The apparatus of claim 19, wherein a mobile device was used by the recipient to initiate the at least one payment transaction __and the processor accesses records of such transactions from the data store__.
